title.narrative: Establishment of an online platform for sharing good living heritage safeguarding experiences

description.narrative:
The establishment of an online platform for sharing good safeguarding experiences is a priority identified under the reflection on a broader implementation of Article 18 of the 2003 Convention, launched by the Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage (Decision 16.COM 14).
The new platform will provide a digital space for communities and other stakeholders to exchange, communicate, and build capacities about safeguarding approaches and methodologies. It will enable the aspirations of the communities to be brought to the fore, addressing needs and highlighting safeguarding experiences that could best reflect the principles and objectives of the 2003 Convention, contributing to raising global awareness of the importance of living heritage safeguarding for sustainable development.
The roadmap for establishing the platform is included in document LHE/24/19.COM/10 and has been examined by the Intergovernmental Committee at its nineteenth session (Decision 19.COM 10). An update on the progress made will be provided at the twentieth session of the Committee in December 2025.
